The '''2017 Copa Libertadores group stage''' was played from 7 March to 25 May 2017.<ref name="dates">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/la-conmebol-dio-conocer-los-calendarios-oficiales-de-las-copas-bridgestone-libertadores-y|title=La CONMEBOL dio a conocer los calendarios oficiales de las copas Bridgestone Libertadores y Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=21 December 2016}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the group stage to decide the 16 places in the [[2017 Copa Libertadores final stages|final stages]] of the [[2017 Copa Libertadores]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/reglamento_conmebol_libertadores_bridgestone_2017_19_01_17_0.pdf|title=Reglamento Conmebol Libertadores Bridgestone 2017|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>

==Draw==
The draw for the group stage was held on 21 December 2016, 20:00 PYST ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref name="draw1">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/abierto-el-proceso-de-acreditacion-medios-de-prensa-para-el-sorteo-de-la-copa-libertadores|title=Abierto el proceso de acreditación a medios de prensa para el sorteo de la Copa Libertadores|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=14 December 2016}}</ref><ref name="draw2">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/asi-quedaron-los-grupos-de-la-copa-conmebol-libertadores-2017|title=Así quedaron los grupos de la Copa CONMEBOL LIBERTADORES 2017|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=21 December 2016}}</ref>

Teams were seeded by their ''CONMEBOL ranking of the Copa Libertadores'' (shown in parentheses),<ref name="ranking1">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/se-conoce-el-nuevo-ranking-de-clubes-de-conmebol-para-la-copa-libertadores|title=Se conoce el nuevo ranking de clubes de CONMEBOL para la Copa Libertadores|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=21 November 2016|language=Spanish}}</ref> taking into account of the following three factors:<ref name="ranking2">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/ranking-conmebol-libertadores2017|title=Ranking Conmebol de Copa Libertadores 2017|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=Spanish}}</ref>
#Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores results in the period 2007–2016
#Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores results in the period 1960–2006
#Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years
<onlyinclude>{{#invoke:transcludable section|main|section=Draw|text=
For the group stage, the 32 teams were drawn into eight groups (Groups 1–8) of four containing a team from each of the four pots. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same group, excluding the winners of the third stage, which were allocated to Pot 4 and whose identity was not known at the time of the draw, and could be drawn into the same group with another team from the same association.

==Format==
<onlyinclude>{{#invoke:transcludable section|main|section=Format|text=
In the group stage, each group was played on a home-and-away [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. The teams were ranked according to [[Points (association football)|points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, and 0 points for a loss). If tied on points, the following criteria would be used to determine the ranking: 1. [[Goal difference]]; 2. Goals scored; 3. Away goals scored; 4. CONMEBOL ranking (Regulations Article 5.1).<ref name="regulations"/>

The winners and runners-up of each group advanced to the [[2017 Copa Libertadores final stages#Round of 16|round of 16]] of the [[2017 Copa Libertadores final stages|knockout stages]]. The third-placed teams of each group entered the [[2017 Copa Sudamericana second stage|Copa Sudamericana second stage]].
}}</onlyinclude>

==Groups==
The fixture list was determined by the draw as follows:
*'''Round 1''': Team 3 vs. Team 1, Team 4 vs. Team 2
*'''Round 2''': Team 1 vs. Team 4, Team 2 vs. Team 3
*'''Round 3''': Team 2 vs. Team 1, Team 3 vs. Team 4
*'''Round 4''': Team 1 vs. Team 2, Team 4 vs. Team 3
*'''Round 5''': Team 4 vs. Team 1, Team 3 vs. Team 2
*'''Round 6''': Team 1 vs. Team 3, Team 2 vs. Team 4

The matches were played on 7–9, 14–16 March, 11–13, 18–20 April, 25–27 April, 2–4, 10, 16–18 and 23–25 May 2017.<ref name="calendar">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/el-calendario-de-disputa-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-bridgestone|title=El calendario de disputa de la CONMEBOL LIBERTADORES BRIDGESTONE|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=28 December 2016}}</ref><ref name="calendar_pdf">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/cla_2017_fixture_general_hf_1_6.pdf|title=PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>
